howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB. Existing bookmarks, if any, are listed automatically.

howto.name: Edit the bookmark tree
howto.text: Add, rename, reorder, or delete bookmarks. Set the target page number for each entry. You can nest bookmarks to create a multi-level table of contents.

howto.name: Save and download
howto.text: Click Save. The updated bookmark tree is embedded into the PDF for easy navigation in any reader.

faq.q: Can I create a multi-level bookmark tree?
faq.a: Yes. You can nest bookmarks under parent entries to create a hierarchical table of contents with multiple levels.

faq.q: Do bookmarks work in all PDF readers?
faq.a: Yes. The bookmarks use the standard PDF outline format supported by Adobe Reader, Preview, Chrome, Firefox, and all major PDF viewers.

faq.q: Can I import a bookmark structure from a text file?
faq.a: Currently, bookmarks are created manually in the editor. You can copy-paste titles and set page numbers individually.
